top_signals.title: CoreWeave Says Nvidia Is ‘Not One Person,’ Remains a Key Partner
top_signals.summary: CoreWeave Inc. has moved to dispel concerns that Jensen Huang’s exit from Nvidia Corp. could affect the chipmaker’s support for neoclouds, with strategy leader Ben Richardson saying it plans to keep working with the company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
